blocks.text: Do'stingizga maslahat berganda o'zbekchada «Shifokorga ko'rinishing **kerak**», «Ertaroq yotsang **yaxshi bo'lardi**», «Dam olganing **ma'qul**» deysiz. Ingliz tilida bularning hammasi **should** bilan aytiladi: You **should** see a doctor. **should** — «menimcha, shunday qilish to'g'ri, yaxshi». U **must** dan yumshoqroq: must — «shart», should — «maslahat beraman». **should** ham modal fe'l: fe'l `to` siz, barcha egalar bilan bir xil shakl, inkor va savol `do` siz (→ 29–31-darslar).

rows: **Should** I call him? — Unga qo'ng'iroq qilaymi?

blocks.text: **should** ikki holatda keladi. Birinchisi — aniq bir kishiga **maslahat**: You **should** take an umbrella — «Soyabon olib ketganing ma'qul». Ikkinchisi — umuman nima **to'g'ri** ekanligi haqidagi fikr: People **should** recycle plastic — «Odamlar plastikni qayta ishlashga topshirishi kerak». Ikkala holatda ham bu so'zlovchining fikri, qat'iy qoida emas: odam maslahatga amal qilmasligi ham mumkin.

items.text: Lola **should** visit her grandparents more often.
items.translation: Lola bobosi va buvisinikiga tez-tez **borib turishi kerak**.
Har bir kishi birinchi yordamni ozgina **bilishi kerak**.

blocks.text: **shouldn't** (= **should not**) — «bunday qilish yaxshi emas, noto'g'ri»: You **shouldn't** eat so late — «Bunchalik kech ovqatlanmaganing ma'qul». O'zbekchaga ko'pincha «...masligi kerak», «...magani ma'qul» deb tarjima qilinadi. **mustn't** (31-dars) bilan solishtiring: mustn't — qat'iy taqiq, shouldn't — faqat «yaxshi emas» degan maslahat.

items.text: You **shouldn't** carry so much money in your pocket.
items.translation: Cho'ntagingizda bunchalik ko'p pul **olib yurmaganingiz ma'qul**.

items.text: Kids **shouldn't** sit in front of a screen all day.
items.translation: Bolalar kun bo'yi ekran oldida **o'tirmasligi kerak**.

blocks.text: I think ... should / I don't think ... should

Maslahatni yumshatish uchun boshiga **I think** qo'shiladi: **I think** you **should** call her — «Menimcha, unga qo'ng'iroq qilishing kerak». Inkor fikrda esa inglizlar **think** ni inkorga qo'yadi: **I don't think** you **should** go — «Menimcha, borishing kerak emas». «I think you shouldn't go» ham xato emas, lekin kamroq eshitiladi. Fikrni so'rash: **Do you think** I **should** ...? — «Sizningcha, ...aymi?»

items.text: I think you **should** apologise to her.
I don't think we **should** spend all our money on the trip.
Do you think I **should** learn German too?

blocks.text: O'zbekchadagi «...aymi?», «...aylikmi?» savollari («Qo'ng'iroq qilaymi?», «Kutaylikmi?») inglizchada ko'pincha **Should I ...? / Should we ...?** bo'ladi. So'roq so'z bilan: **What should** I do? — «Nima qilay?», **Where should** we go? — «Qayerga boraylik?». Bunday savol bilan siz boshqa odamning fikrini, maslahatini so'raysiz.
**ought to** ham **should** bilan bir xil ma'noda: You **ought to** rest = You **should** rest. Lekin u kamroq ishlatiladi va undan keyin `to` keladi. Boshlang'ich darajada **should** yetarli.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You should to go.» → **You should go.**; «She shoulds rest.» → **She should rest.**; «Do I should call him?» → **Should I call him?**; «I think you don't should go.» → **I don't think you should go.**; qat'iy qoidada **should** emas, **must** kerak: «Passengers should have a ticket» emas, **Passengers must have a ticket.**

Eslab qolish: o'zbekcha «...sang yaxshi bo'lardi», «...ganing ma'qul», «menimcha, ...ish kerak» — **should**; «...aymi?» deb maslahat so'rash — **Should I ...?**. Agar gapda «shart» desangiz — **must** yoki **have to** (→ 33-dars).

examples.title: **should**: giving advice
examples.description: Maslahat: **should** + fe'l = «...ishing kerak», «...ganing ma'qul». Gaplar turli egalar bilan, fe'l doim `to` siz.

sentences.text: You **should** drink more water in this hot weather.
sentences.translation: Bunday issiq havoda ko'proq suv **ichishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Your tooth still hurts? Then you **should** see a dentist.
sentences.translation: Tishingiz hali ham og'riyaptimi? Unda tish shifokoriga **ko'rinishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Aziz, you **should** take a break — you look exhausted.
sentences.translation: Aziz, biroz **dam olganing ma'qul** — juda charchagan ko'rinasan.

sentences.text: The new café on Navoi Street is great. You **should** try their soup.
sentences.translation: Navoiy ko'chasidagi yangi kafe zo'r. Ularning sho'rvasini **tatib ko'rishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Students **should** start revising at least a month before the exams.
sentences.translation: Talabalar imtihonlardan kamida bir oy oldin **takrorlashni boshlashlari kerak**.

sentences.text: When you visit London, you **should** see the British Museum — it's free.
sentences.translation: Londonga borganingizda Britaniya muzeyini albatta **ko'ring** — kirish bepul.

sentences.text: Madina **should** wear a warmer coat; it's freezing outside.
sentences.translation: Madina issiqroq palto **kiyishi kerak**: tashqarida qahraton sovuq.

sentences.text: We **should** leave now — the last bus goes at eleven.
sentences.translation: Hozir **chiqishimiz kerak** — oxirgi avtobus soat o'n birda ketadi.

sentences.text: Maybe you **should** talk to your teacher about the problem.
sentences.translation: Balki bu muammo haqida o'qituvchingiz bilan **gaplashganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Bekzod's English is good, but he **should** practise speaking more often.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning inglizchasi yaxshi, lekin u gapirishni tez-tez **mashq qilishi kerak**.

examples.title: **shouldn't**: it isn't a good idea
examples.description: **shouldn't** = «...masligi kerak», «...magani ma'qul»: bu ish yaxshi emas. Bu qat'iy taqiq (mustn't) emas, maslahat.

sentences.text: You **shouldn't** eat so much sugar.
sentences.translation: Bunchalik ko'p shakar **yemasligingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Children **shouldn't** watch TV for hours every day.
sentences.translation: Bolalar har kuni soatlab televizor **ko'rmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Tom **shouldn't** drive today — he's very tired.
sentences.translation: Tom bugun **mashina haydamagani ma'qul** — u juda charchagan.

sentences.text: We **shouldn't** leave the windows open when we go out.
sentences.translation: Ko'chaga chiqqanda derazalarni ochiq **qoldirmasligimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: I **shouldn't** drink coffee in the evening — then I can't sleep.
sentences.translation: Kechqurun qahva **ichmasligim kerak** — keyin uxlay olmayman.

sentences.text: Dilnoza, you **shouldn't** go out with wet hair in winter.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza, qishda ho'l soch bilan tashqariga **chiqmasliging kerak**.

sentences.text: People **shouldn't** use their phones in the cinema.
sentences.translation: Kinoteatrda odamlar telefondan **foydalanmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: It's a very expensive restaurant, so we **shouldn't** order the most expensive dishes.
sentences.translation: Bu juda qimmat restoran, shuning uchun eng qimmat taomlarni **buyurtma qilmaganimiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: My sister **shouldn't** work so late every night — she needs more sleep.
sentences.translation: Opam har kecha bunchalik kech **ishlamasligi kerak** — unga ko'proq uyqu kerak.

sentences.text: You look ill. You **shouldn't** go to work tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Kasalga o'xshaysiz. Ertaga ishga **bormaganingiz ma'qul**.

examples.title: **should**: what is right in general
examples.description: **should** umumiy fikrda ham keladi: «odamlar, maktablar, shahar ... shunday qilishi kerak». Bu — so'zlovchining nima to'g'ri ekanligi haqidagi fikri.

sentences.text: Everybody **should** learn to swim.
sentences.translation: Har bir inson **suzishni o'rganishi kerak**.

sentences.text: The city **should** build more parks for children.
sentences.translation: Shahar bolalar uchun ko'proq bog' **qurishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Doctors **should** explain things clearly to their patients.
sentences.translation: Shifokorlar bemorlarga hamma narsani aniq **tushuntirishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Young people **should** respect older people.
sentences.translation: Yoshlar kattalarni **hurmat qilishi kerak**.

sentences.text: In my opinion, schools **should** teach children how to cook.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, maktablar bolalarga **ovqat pishirishni o'rgatishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Shops **shouldn't** sell cigarettes to teenagers.
sentences.translation: Do'konlar o'smirlarga sigaret **sotmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: A good manager **should** listen to the team.
sentences.translation: Yaxshi rahbar jamoasini **tinglashi kerak**.

sentences.text: Public transport **should** be cheap and comfortable.
sentences.translation: Jamoat transporti arzon va qulay **bo'lishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Parents **should** read to their children every evening.
sentences.translation: Ota-onalar har oqshom bolalariga kitob **o'qib berishi kerak**.

sentences.text: Tourists **should** be polite and respect local customs when they visit Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Sayyohlar Buxoroga kelganda xushmuomala **bo'lishi** va mahalliy urf-odatlarni **hurmat qilishi kerak**.

examples.title: **I think** ... **should**
examples.description: Maslahatni yumshatish: **I think** you **should** ... — «Menimcha, ...ishingiz kerak». Fikr boshqa kishiniki ham bo'lishi mumkin: Tom **thinks** we **should** ...

sentences.text: I think you **should** apply for that job.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, o'sha ishga **ariza topshirishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: My doctor thinks I **should** walk more.
sentences.translation: Shifokorimning fikricha, ko'proq **yurishim kerak**.

sentences.text: Tom thinks we **should** book the hotel now, before prices go up.
sentences.translation: Tomning fikricha, narxlar oshmasdan oldin mehmonxonani hozir **band qilishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Honestly, I think Madina **should** study law — she loves arguing!
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, menimcha Madina huquqshunoslikni **o'qishi kerak** — u bahslashishni yaxshi ko'radi!

sentences.text: Everyone thinks the government **should** do more for the environment.
sentences.translation: Hamma hukumat atrof-muhit uchun ko'proq **ish qilishi kerak**, deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: My parents think I **should** get married soon.
sentences.translation: Ota-onamning fikricha, tezroq **uylanishim kerak**.

sentences.text: It's your decision, but I think you **should** talk to him first.
sentences.translation: Bu sizning qaroringiz, lekin menimcha, avval u bilan **gaplashib olishingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Sarah thinks the children **should** go to bed earlier on school days.
sentences.translation: Saraning fikricha, bolalar o'qish kunlari ertaroq **yotishi kerak**.

sentences.text: We all think Bekzod **should** be the captain of the team.
sentences.translation: Hammamiz Bekzod jamoa sardori **bo'lishi kerak**, deb o'ylaymiz.

sentences.text: Personally, I think we **should** stay in Samarkand one more day.
sentences.translation: Shaxsan men Samarqandda yana bir kun **qolishimiz kerak**, deb o'ylayman.

examples.title: **I don't think** ... **should**
examples.description: Inkor maslahat: **I don't think** you **should** ... — «Menimcha, ...masligingiz kerak». Inglizlar inkorni think ga qo'yishni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: I don't think you **should** go out in this rain.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, bunday yomg'irda tashqariga **chiqmasligingiz kerak**.

sentences.text: My brother doesn't think we **should** sell the old house.
sentences.translation: Akam eski uyni **sotmasligimiz kerak**, deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: I don't think children **should** have smartphones before the age of twelve.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, o'n ikki yoshgacha bolalarda smartfon **bo'lmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Emma doesn't think she **should** tell her boss about the mistake.
sentences.translation: Emma xato haqida xo'jayiniga **aytmasligi kerak**, deb o'ylaydi.

sentences.text: We don't think the shop **should** close so early on Saturdays.
sentences.translation: Bizningcha, do'kon shanba kunlari bunchalik erta **yopilmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Honestly, I don't think Aziz **should** buy such an expensive car.
sentences.translation: Rostini aytsam, menimcha Aziz bunday qimmat mashina **olmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: The doctor doesn't think Grandma **should** travel this month.
sentences.translation: Shifokorning fikricha, buvim bu oy **safarga chiqmasligi kerak**.

sentences.text: Do you think I **should** call her? — No, I don't think you **should**.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, unga **qo'ng'iroq qilaymi**? — Yo'q, menimcha, **kerak emas**.

sentences.text: Most teachers don't think students **should** use phones in class.
sentences.translation: Ko'pchilik o'qituvchilar talabalar darsda telefondan **foydalanmasligi kerak**, deb hisoblaydi.

sentences.text: Sorry, but I don't think we **should** wait for Tom any longer — he's always late.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, lekin menimcha, Tomni boshqa **kutmasligimiz kerak** — u doim kechikadi.

examples.title: Asking for advice: **Should I ...?** **What should I ...?**
examples.description: Maslahat so'rash: **Should I ...?** — «...aymi?», **What / Where / Which ... should I ...?** — «Nima / qayerga / qaysi ...?». Javob: **Yes, you should.** / **No, you shouldn't.**

sentences.text: **Should** I call a taxi? — Yes, you **should**. It's raining.
sentences.translation: Taksi **chaqiraymi**? — Ha, **chaqiring**. Yomg'ir yog'yapti.

sentences.text: What **should** I wear to the wedding?
sentences.translation: To'yga nima **kiyay**?

sentences.text: Where **should** we park the car? — Behind the hotel.
sentences.translation: Mashinani qayerga **qo'yaylik**? — Mehmonxona orqasiga.

sentences.text: **Should** we tell the teacher about it? — Yes, I think we **should**.
sentences.translation: Bu haqda o'qituvchiga **aytaylikmi**? — Ha, menimcha, **aytishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: Do you think I **should** buy this dress or the blue one? — The blue one, definitely.
sentences.translation: Sizningcha, shu ko'ylakni **olaymi** yoki ko'kini? — Albatta ko'kini.

sentences.text: How much **should** we leave as a tip in London restaurants? — About ten per cent.
sentences.translation: London restoranlarida qancha choy puli **qoldirishimiz kerak**? — Taxminan o'n foiz.

sentences.text: Which bus **should** I take to get to the Registan? — The number ten.
sentences.translation: Registonga borish uchun qaysi avtobusga **o'tiray**? — O'ninchi avtobusga.

sentences.text: When **should** Madina start taking the medicine? — Tonight, after dinner.
sentences.translation: Madina dorini qachondan **ichishni boshlashi kerak**? — Bugun kechqurun, kechki ovqatdan keyin.

sentences.text: Aziz has a job offer in Manchester. **Should** he accept it?
sentences.translation: Azizga Manchesterdan ish taklif qilishdi. U taklifni **qabul qilsinmi**?

sentences.text: **Should** I wake Dad up? — No, you **shouldn't**. He's very tired.
sentences.translation: Dadamni **uyg'otaymi**? — Yo'q, **uyg'otma**. U juda charchagan.

examples.title: **must**, **should** or **don't need to**?
examples.description: Kuch darajasi: **must** / **mustn't** — shart / taqiq (qoida), **should** — maslahat, **don't need to** — shart emas. Bir vaziyatda ikkitasi yonma-yon.

sentences.text: You **must** have a ticket to travel, and you **should** buy it online — it's cheaper.
sentences.translation: Yo'lga chiqish uchun chiptangiz **bo'lishi shart**, uni internetdan **olganingiz ma'qul** — arzonroq.

sentences.text: Drivers **must** stop at a red light, and they **should** slow down near schools.
sentences.translation: Haydovchilar qizil chiroqda **to'xtashi shart**, maktablar yaqinida esa **sekinlashgani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: You **don't need to** bring a towel, but you **should** bring a swimsuit.
sentences.translation: Sochiq **olib kelishingiz shart emas**, lekin cho'milish kiyimini **olib kelganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **must** pass this exam to get into university, so he **should** study every evening.
sentences.translation: Bekzod universitetga kirish uchun bu imtihondan **o'tishi shart**, shuning uchun har kecha **o'qishi kerak**.

sentences.text: On the building site workers **must** wear helmets, and they **should** check their equipment every morning.
sentences.translation: Qurilish maydonida ishchilar dubulg'a **kiyishi shart**, har kuni ertalab jihozlarini ham **tekshirib turishi kerak**.

sentences.text: You **should** call Grandma more often, but you **don't need to** call every day.
sentences.translation: Buvimga tez-tez **qo'ng'iroq qilib turishing kerak**, lekin har kuni **qo'ng'iroq qilishing shart emas**.

sentences.text: Emma **doesn't need to** learn every word, but she **should** learn the most common ones.
sentences.translation: Emma har bir so'zni **yodlashi shart emas**, lekin eng ko'p ishlatiladiganlarini **o'rgangani ma'qul**.

sentences.text: To get a visa, you **must** fill in this form, and you **should** keep a copy for yourself.
sentences.translation: Viza olish uchun bu anketani **to'ldirishingiz shart**, nusxasini esa o'zingizda **saqlab qo'yganingiz ma'qul**.

sentences.text: The party is informal, so we **don't need to** dress up, but we **should** bring something to eat.
sentences.translation: Bazm norasmiy, shuning uchun **yasanishimiz shart emas**, lekin yeyishga biror narsa **olib borishimiz kerak**.

sentences.text: At the gym you **mustn't** use the machines without a trainer, and you **should** drink plenty of water.
sentences.translation: Sport zalida trenersiz trenajyorlardan **foydalanish mumkin emas**, ko'p suv **ichish ham kerak**.

examples.title: Dialogue: advice before a job interview
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: Madina do'sti Jeymsdan ish suhbati oldidan maslahat so'raydi — **Should I ...?**, **What should I ...?**, **should**, **shouldn't**, **I think / I don't think**.

sentences.text: — James, I've got a job interview on Monday. What **should** I do to prepare?
sentences.translation: — Jeyms, dushanba kuni ish suhbatim bor. Tayyorlanish uchun nima **qilishim kerak**?

sentences.text: — First, you **should** read about the company on its website.
sentences.translation: — Avvalo, kompaniya haqida uning saytidan **o'qib chiqishing kerak**.

sentences.text: — Good idea. **Should** I wear a suit?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Kostyum **kiyaymi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, I think you **should**. It's a big bank, so it's quite formal.
sentences.translation: — Ha, menimcha, **kiyishing kerak**. Bu katta bank, u yerda hamma narsa ancha rasmiy.

sentences.text: — And **should** I take a copy of my CV?
sentences.translation: — Rezyumemning nusxasini ham **olib boraymi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, take two copies. And of course you **shouldn't** arrive late.
sentences.translation: — Ha, ikki nusxa ol. Va, albatta, **kechikmasliging kerak**.

sentences.text: — How early **should** I get there?
sentences.translation: — U yerga qancha erta **borishim kerak**?

sentences.text: — About fifteen minutes before. You **don't need to** be there an hour early.
sentences.translation: — Taxminan o'n besh daqiqa oldin. Bir soat oldin **borishing shart emas**.

sentences.text: — I'm really nervous. I don't think I **should** talk a lot about my old job.
sentences.translation: — Juda hayajondaman. Menimcha, eski ishim haqida ko'p **gapirmasligim kerak**.

sentences.text: — Right. You **should** just be yourself and smile. You'll be fine!
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri. Shunchaki o'zing bo'lib, **jilmayib tursang bo'ldi**. Hammasi yaxshi bo'ladi!
